title: S5 risk-manager — API surface
description: Port 7650, prefix RKM-. Endpoints (from router): GET /healthz, /readyz, /limits, /exposure, /kill-switch, /breaches, /stats; PUT /limits; DELETE /limits (reset); POST /pre-trade-check; POST /kill-switch (engage); POST /kill-switch/disengage. Pre-trade check returns 200 when allowed, 409 when vetoed (HARD breach).

preTradeCheckRequest.description: POST /pre-trade-check. Advisory/veto: the risk manager never mutates positions here. Required: symbol, side, qty (non-zero). limit_px defaults to 0.0 (market).

qty.description: Quantity in lots; must be non-zero (may be negative to denote a reduce/flip in some callers; the parser rejects 0).

limit_px.description: Limit price (aliases: limit_price, px). Defaults to 0.0.

preTradeCheckResponse.description: CheckResult.to_dict(request) + checked_ns. HTTP 200 when allowed, 409 when vetoed (hard_breached=true). Escalation of HARD breaches (kill-switch / S10 alert / S13 audit) is best-effort and never blocks the response.

breached.description: true if any verdict failed (SOFT or HARD).

hard_breached.description: true if any HARD verdict failed (=> veto, HTTP 409).

request_id.description: The (server-stamped if absent) request id, e.g. PRT-<now_ns>.

name.description: Named check (e.g. kill_switch, param_sanity, velocity, open_order_cap, position_limit, notional_limit, portfolio_notional).

severity.description: HARD => veto; SOFT => warn without veto.

checked_ns.description: Wall-clock time the check ran, int64 ns.

limits.description: RiskLimits (PUT /limits body, GET /limits response). PUT accepts any subset and merges; DELETE /limits resets to defaults.

symbol_overrides.description: Per-symbol overrides keyed by canonical symbol; values may override max_position_qty / max_notional_per_symbol.

killSwitchRequest.description: POST /kill-switch (engage) and POST /kill-switch/disengage. Both accept an optional actor/note.
